input.text: Vertical video, one continuous shot from a static camera placed low near the road surface, 6 seconds. Early morning, an empty Indian city street, cool light with the low sun behind camera-right rim-lighting the runner. One woman in plain running kit sprints from the far end of the street straight toward the camera at full speed, arms pumping, and passes close by on the right, her running shoes filling the lower frame for a moment as she goes. Same woman throughout, natural stride, no slow motion. Only natural street sound: footfalls, birds, distant traffic; no speech, no music. Real, not glossy. No text, captions, logos or lettering anywhere in any frame.
